value.rationale: The mass coefficient is a practical tuning choice in recently proposed mesh- and horizon-robust nonlocal preconditioners. This exact natural 1D benchmark resolves the entire one-parameter continuum worst-horizon minimax problem, identifies the resonant-frequency bottleneck forcing b*>1/6, and proves a greater-than-2.36 sharp-condition-number improvement over the source mass scaling. The claim is more than an arbitrary numerical coefficient, yet makes no unproved extension to discretized volume constraints.
